text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …Huh? A LANE message?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Can you solve this riddle? ♪ In a game of hide-and-seek, what one seeks is often hiding in plain sight!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …Tch. She's thought of a new way to annoy me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And now to send her my next hint! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I hope she's enjoying this. All that's left now is the final photo…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thwunk!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, where are my manners—wait, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Sorry for bumping into you. I was having so much fun that I must've forgotten to look where I was going.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I thought you'd never ask. ♪ Actually, I've just challenged Air Shakur to a game of hide-and-seek.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But this is no ordinary game. This hide-and-seek has riddles!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's right. Air Shakur would never agree to a simple game of hide-and-seek, would she?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: So, I've spiced up the formula by arranging it so she can deduce the hiding spot by solving riddles. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I thought I could get Shakur to join in if I used some super-difficult brainteasers!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! Why don't you join in on the fun too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Here's the riddle! In a game of hide-and-seek, what one seeks is often hiding in plain sight. You've got to find the correct location using these three photos.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The first photo is of a Mejiro household tea party. Three cups for three attendees!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The second photo is of the library. One student is frantically leafing through her book!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And once we've taken a photo of a clubroom sign and sent it, that'll be all of the clues! Think you can solve the riddle?
choice_data_list: Could you give me more time to think?
Could you give me more time to think?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, sure thing. You can mull it over while we're on the move. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After taking a photo of the clubroom, the two of us find ourselves in the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Remember how I said that in hide-and-seek, what one seeks is often hiding in plain sight?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The clues are all right there in the photos. You just have to look closely and think carefully.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: In the first photo, there are three cups of tea.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Then, in the second photo, you can see a student leafing through a book. And as for the last picture, well, once you have the first two hints, it's fairly obvious!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: So, the correct answer is "three-leaf club"! And that hints at the name of the tasty ramen restaurant that Shakur and I always visit—Three-Leaf Clover!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …Took you long enough.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow! Shakur, did you solve the riddle already?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I haven't solved squat, dummy. I just dropped by all the places I figured you might choose. It's called knowing the meta.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm guessing you thought I'd want to crack your code, but that's not happening. Too bad, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Not at all, I'm quite delighted!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …What?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Well, you deduced the answer without even needing the clues. That's so like you, Shakur. And besides…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The fact that this place was on your list must mean that it holds a special place in your heart, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hragh?!
choice_data_list: You two really get along well.
You two really get along well.
We've got to outsmart Shakur next time!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hragh?!
choice_data_list: You two really get along well.
You two really get along well.
We've got to outsmart Shakur next time!

text_block_list.name: Fine & Shakur
text_block_list.text: What gives you that idea?! We certainly do. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I've made so many wonderful memories with Shakur here. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: She was the one who told me I could actually customize my order.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Like I'd remember doing something like that. …You know what, I'm done here.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, now wait just a second. There's a tasty prize in store for you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I think I'll have… Yes, ramen with no green onions and plenty of bamboo shoots, and I'll ask them to skim the fat too. ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …Tch. One bowl and I'm going home.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Shakur looks like she thinks it'd be more of a hassle to resist. Nonetheless, she looks to be on good terms with Fine Motion as they both sit together.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah, one dummy becomes two. Beating me in a battle of wits? Dream on.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: How about I do the riddling next time? Sure hope you can solve my puzzle before you leave Japan, princess.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you're on! The two of us will solve it for sure.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Look at you, buddying up at the drop of a hat. You really are full of surprises, huh.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Why thank you for the compliment, Shakur. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though Air Shakur curtly denies that she was offering any praise, Fine Motion is hardly fazed. These two have quite the interesting dynamic.
